budget: original shared USD 1, cumulative with v1; not a new allowance
evidence_gate: Source identity, original abstract section and bounded length are checked independently of relevance. A negative relevance score is never manufactured for a missing abstract.
revised_handling_test: Offline gate ablation: remove an abstract and verify insufficient-evidence/null relevance/no call. The live old-rubric/full-abstract run isolates evidence completion; no prompt tuning to perfect five labels.
model_output_policy: Preserve actual raw score distributions, returned model and usage; no hardcoded user labels or score overrides.
public_artifacts: Source URL/provenance/abstract hash and size; request hash and rubric version; sanitized model outputs and cumulative cost. No raw newly retrieved abstracts or full raw requests.
labels: strictly local; never published or sent to model
quality_claim: development sanity checks only; no held-out evidence or true Jina baseline
execution: manual Test workflow on existing experimental branch only; no automatic dispatch/retry; production unchanged
